programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.desc: S10 E07 — Finshes at BKFC 62! In four tough-fought wars, we see none of these bouts go the distance! Watch BKFC talent battle with SIMPSON vs SUAREZ, ZUCKERMAN vs CEDENO, PLAZAOLA vs DODSON & GARCIA vs LIVINGSTON at BKFC 62.
programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up

programme.desc: S10 E10 — California goes CRAZY for Bare Knuckle Not a single fight from Pechanga disappointed the live audience, nor the viewers at home! programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up
